## What's new

- Game Boy or Color, sorted: every Game Boy game plays on the machine it was made for, whatever its file is called. Indie games from itch.io and GB Studio named .gb that are really Game Boy Color play in color, and black-and-white games are never tinted. Both folders show .gb and .gbc files.
- ChaOS looks for Game Boy games in the wrong folder after ChaOS Transfer sends anything and once a week, and asks before moving them, with their saves, states, box art, play time, favorites and cheats. Or sort them any time: MENU > ROM Management > Sort Game Boy Games.
- With PT SkyWalker541 on, the emulator is set the way the shader is tuned: color correction and frame blending for each Game Boy and GBA, as its README recommends. Changes in the in-game menu show at once.
- Fancy Pants: a polished steel watch for Recently Played, and a new, realistic arcade stick for Ports.
- Questions in pop-ups no longer run out of their box.

---

ChaOS 2.3.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.3.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.3.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
